description: This file defines a Java class 'ImmutableFeaturePropertiesBuilder' which is a mutable builder for 'ImmutableFeatureProperties' objects, providing a fluent API for constructing JSON-based feature properties.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturePropertiesBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing FeaturePropertiesBuilder, providing methods to set, remove, and build feature properties as JSON objects.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new empty instance of ImmutableFeaturePropertiesBuilder.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableFeaturePropertiesBuilder initialized with values from a given JsonObject.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with various data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, JsonFieldDefinition) with an optional predicate.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField with an optional predicate.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field by key or JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields from an iterable of JsonFields with an optional predicate.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all fields from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableFeatureProperties object from the current state.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the builder has no fields set.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of fields set in the builder.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of JsonFields in the builder.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on jsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on jsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the builder.
